english.note: Use this for a large formal assembly or a named body such as the United Nations General Assembly, rather than for an ordinary gathering or a generic legislature.
Use this for a large organization- or industry-wide convention focused on a public or business issue.

examples.english: The United Nations General Assembly will meet next week.
examples.traditional: 聯合國大會下星期開會。
